data.description: Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/carry#d2): Refine the record-use rule into two named uses. Operational use of the shared artifact — posting tasks with done-lines, claiming against actual shifts, marking completion, re-claiming misses, initiating line-rewrites — is open and continuous, handled at short check-ins as needed. Evaluative use — claimed-versus-completed totals, fairness, deciding the branch — is reserved for the dated standing review. No private tallies of either kind. Check-in frequency is set by the flatmates at proposal time; the standing review keeps the pre-agreed revision date.
